text: This report provides information on the status of the Exhibition Place health and safety system, specifically on activities, priorities, and performance during the second quarter of 2020. There were 0 lost time injuries and a 75 percent decrease in medical aid injuries in the second quarter of 2020 relative to the second quarter of 2019. Workplace Safety and Insurance Board (WSIB) invoice costs for the second quarter of 2020 were approximately 60 percent lower to those in the second quarter of 2019. This is attributable to decreased incident costs and lower Long Time Disability costs.
The Board of Governors of Exhibition Place: 1. Received the report (September 3, 2020) from the Chief Executive Officer, Exhibition Place for information.
